Configuration file

SpPrAn is controlled by a YAML configuration file. Users can create it manually from config/config_example.yaml or with the SpPrAn Configuration Builder.

Analysis type

type_of_analysis accepts:

supervised

User-defined major cell types and hierarchical subtypes.

unsupervised

User-defined major cell types followed by exploratory marker-pattern discovery within selected parents.

full

Unsupervised discovery followed by conversion of discovered patterns into subtype definitions and execution of the supervised workflow.

Missing or invalid values default to supervised for backward compatibility.

Shared settings

workspace

Input directory, output directory, and tsv/csv file type.

protein_markers

List that contains the primary protein markers to be used in the cell type definitions. Protein markers name must have one of the following formats:

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name} (MV Cell)”

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name}* (MV Cell)”

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name} (MV - NUC)”

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name}* (MV - NUC)”

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name} (MV - CYTO)”

  • “Positivity - {protein_marker_name}* (MV - CYTO)”

cell_types

Dictionary, where the keys are the cell type names and the values are a list with the detected intensity signal preserving the same order as protein_markers. Primary phenotype definitions inside a cell type use 1 for positive, 0 for negative, and ~/null for unconstrained markers.

custom_colors

Dictionary where the keys are the cell type or subtype names and the values are hexadecimal color codes used to represent each population in plots or other visual outputs. Cell type and subtype names cannot be the same.

locally_save_anndata_files

Whether annotated AnnData objects should be saved. true or false values are only accepted.

overwrite_existing_files

Whether existing output files may be replaced.``true`` or false values are only accepted.

arrows_orientation

For the cell hierarchy plot, arrows_orientation will change the orientation of the arrows. contains value will show arrows from up to down, and isContained value will show arrows from down to up.

Supervised-only settings

sub_cell_types

nested dictionary, where the first-level keys are the parent cell type and subtypes names and the values are dictionaries defining cell subtypes within that parent population. Each cell subtype name maps to a dictionary where the keys are protein markers and the values define the phenotype: 1 for positive, 0 for negative, and ~/null for unconstrained markers. Cell type and subtype names cannot be the same.

spatial_plot

dictionary containing the parameters used to generate spatial plots. dpi defines the plot resolution, scatter_point_size controls the size of the plotted cells or objects, and plot_options specifies the plotting mode.

The values for plot_options are overview, highlight, all, none, and custom. For more information, see SpPrAn Configuration Builder. When plot_options is set to custom, the custom_plot option is a list with the input files to plot, where each entry is a dictionary that defines the input fileName and the corresponding plot type similar to plot_options (except for custom value).

Unsupervised/full settings

cell_types_to_explore

List with the cell types within which phenotypes should be discovered. Cell types names must be exactly the same as in cell_types, but not necessarily in the same order.

cell_types_to_explore_short_name

List with the short names corresponding to the selected cell types in cell_types_to_explore. Short names must be different each other.

exploratory_protein_markers

List with the protein markers used for exploratory phenotype discovery. Protein marker names must be exactly the same as appear in the input files.

exploratory_protein_markers_short_name

List with the short names corresponding to the exploratory protein markers. Short names must be different each other.

want_to_plot_pie_plots

Boolean controlling sample-level composition pie plots. true or false values are only accepted.

dict_ctrl and dict_trtmnt

Optional filename-to-group dictionary mappings for two-group comparison. Keys are filenames in the input folder and values is the corresponding group name. Group names must be different between them, and each dictionary must not contain a similar key. Both dictionaries can be empty only at the same time.

protein_markers_for_intensity

Optional list with the protein markers for summarized intensity measurements. Protein marker names must be exactly the same as appear in the input files. This list can be empty.

intensity_spatial_plot

Optional dictionary controlling continuous protein-intensity spatial plots. dpi defines the plot resolution and scatter_point_size controls the size of the plotted cells or objects.

nhood_analysis

Optional fixed-radius neighborhood-analysis settings. nhood_radius_size controls the neighborhood radius in the input data units, pixel_conversion_rate establishes the scale between desired units (in terms of the input data units) and pixel units for spatial cell coordinates, max_distance_coocurrence controls the maximum distance for the co-occurrence plot, and dpi defines all these plots’ resolution.

advanced_cell_classification

Boolean enabling low/medium/high protein-intensity characterization within discovered phenotypes.

Validation

SpPrAn validates mode-specific settings before analysis.

See Analysis modes for analytical interpretation.
